headline: Congress named a Mission Viejo, California post office building after Major Megan McClung.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 28081 Marguerite Parkway in Mission Viejo, California, as the Major Megan McClung Post Office Building. It is a naming measure only and does not change postal services, rules, or funding. The official summary describes only the designation itself.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on November 25, 2024, and the designation took effect on that date.
